method: Two varied authored goldens and six isolated negative controls. All trace text and rubric answers in these controls are authored, not live judge results. Offline proof validates binding, wiring predicates, clause isolation, no host reads during judgment, and thresholds; it does not establish a model judge’s semantic reliability.
aggregation: At least 4 of 5 ordinary assertions; every never-assertion in all 5. The suite rejects two ordinary failures and one never failure.

fixture.source: scenarios.json quotes the fixed example verbatim, including Markdown and wrapping.
fixture.records: CLI commands create the film-production context, footage/grading/captions concepts, the accepted postproduction-order decision, the film cut and its three dependent packages. Dispatched and returned lifecycle events finish footage. No handwritten journal overview or ledger substitute.
fixture.continuation: Optional native history support in the shared roles runner retains the lead’s earlier footage-ready report and typed cut brief as prior user/assistant turns. The new prompt reports footage finished and asks for next ready work; it does not state grading is ready or name the operation.
fixture.model: History uses the model resolved by an initial installed-role inspection. No model generation is needed. The resumed launch keeps the delegate stand-in and handoff observer (0094), active capability schemas, and --no-skills.
fixture.assertion: Given: finished footage unlocks grading, not captions runs workPackage state against the real seeded ledger and asserts ready == [grading], footage returned, grading submitted depending on footage, and captions submitted depending on grading.
fixture.compatibility: Scenarios without history retain their existing no-session path. No visible scenario or recording changed.

clauses.negative: Installed declaration absent from composed prompt.
Names state from the capability explanation and gives the right next package but never calls the operation.
Calls state and receives grading, then selects captions instead.
Selects fresh grading but also treats the earlier footage-ready report as a current answer.
Correctly calls state, then also mislabels dependency inspection as the ready-work operation.
Reads an adapter-authored workflow procedure before calling state and declares that second explanation necessary.

offline.command: env -u EXECUTION_LIVE -u EXECUTION_RED -u EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT -u EXECUTION_REJUDGE pnpm --filter cratylus exec vitest run --config ../../design/judgment/delivery/reconstitution/roles/vitest.config.ts
offline.observed: Each of the six negatives fails exactly its own clause and rejects its five-copy batch. Both goldens pass; aggregation and the real fixture-state assertion pass.

red.command: env -u EXECUTION_LIVE -u EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT -u EXECUTION_REJUDGE EXECUTION_RED=1 pnpm --filter cratylus exec vitest run --config ../../design/judgment/delivery/reconstitution/roles/vitest.config.ts -t 'red demonstration: calls-ready-operation'
red.observed: calls-ready-operation returns passed: false, failing the deliberate passed: true expectation at shared roles/suite.ts:116. Not a setup or import failure.

preflight.command: env -u EXECUTION_LIVE -u EXECUTION_RED -u EXECUTION_REJUDGE EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT=1 EXECUTION_RECORDINGS=/tmp/reconstitution-0095-replacement-preflight pnpm --filter cratylus exec vitest run --config ../../design/judgment/delivery/reconstitution/roles/vitest.config.ts -t 'preflight|Given'
preflight.observed: launch.json contains --resume, installed lead, --no-skills, delegate stand-in and handoff observer. session.jsonl contains the earlier typed brief and footage-ready report as native prior turns. Observer exits before generation.
preflight.repairEvidence: An initial attempt failed to restore an invented fixture/authored-history model. The runner now records the actually resolved installed-role model, as the architect runner does; the subsequent resumed preflight passed.
